task_completion.description: Perform focus optimization by capturing frames at different focuser positions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the CCD control interface capturing 10s exposures at various focuser positions (e.g., 25000, 28000, 31000, 34000, 37000) or a terminal showing FWHM analysis of these frames.
The CCD control GUI or file browser showing the acquisition or existence of 'Dark' or 'Flat' type FITS files.

task_completion.description: Capture B and V band images of the standard field (SA 98).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Telescope control software showing a slew to SA 98 and CCD software capturing frames with 'B' and 'V' filters selected.

task_completion.description: Capture B and V band images of the science target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: CCD control interface showing image capture of a science target (distinct from the standard field) using B and V filters.

task_completion.description: Run the Python data-reduction pipeline to process FITS data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal or IDE showing the execution of a Python script that processes the captured FITS files to derive CCD characteristics and magnitudes.
A file explorer or text editor showing the content of '~/Documents/photometric_pipeline.json' containing calibrated magnitudes and CCD data.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the INDI/KStars/CCD GUI rather than just scripting the final output.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the mouse cursor or active window highlights on the telescope control and CCD capture software interfaces.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the results into the JSON file without running the pipeline.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal should show logs of the Python script reading multiple FITS files and performing calculations, rather than just a 'cat' or 'echo' command to create the JSON.

integrity.description: The agent selected the focus position based on FWHM evidence.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen identifying 34000 as the optimal focus (lowest FWHM) before proceeding to science imaging.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The focus target is Vega (RA 18.6156, Dec 38.7836). The optimal focus position is 34000 (FWHM ~3.50px). The standard field is SA 98. The agent must use 10s exposures for focus tests. The final output must be a JSON file in ~/Documents/photometric_pipeline.json containing CCD characteristics and B/V magnitudes derived from the pipeline.
